_comment: Amigos free-servers.json — EXAMPLE FILE WITH PLACEHOLDER ENTRIES ONLY. Do NOT ship real server credentials in the app repo. Host the real file at https://amigos.r4in8ow.online/free-servers.json (or change FREE_SERVERS_URL build constant). The app fetches it over HTTPS, validates the schema below, caches it locally, and imports supported links.

_schema.servers: array of server objects (required, may be empty)
_schema.servers[].country_code: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code used for the badge (string, optional, e.g. SG)
_schema.servers[].link: full proxy URI matching the type, e.g. vless://... (string, required; must start with <type>://)
_schema.servers[].name: display name for this server (string, required, e.g. SG Free #1)
_schema.servers[].region: human-readable region name shown in the app (string, required, e.g. Singapore)
_schema.servers[].type: one of: vless, vmess, trojan, ss (string, required; unknown types are ignored by the app)
_schema.updated_at: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this list was last curated (string, required, e.g. 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z)
